mercato → validazione<\/span><\/h2><div class=\"desk-panel-body\"><p class=\"desk-text\">Uno scenario diventa interessante quando i nuovi dati si allineano, il <strong>repricing OIS<\/strong> e il <strong>2Y<\/strong> si muovono nella direzione prevista, e FX/asset risk rispondono coerentemente. Se il prezzo non segue il driver, il quadro resta non validato.<\/p><div class=\"desk-note\">Nessuna probabilità soggettiva spacciata per quantitativa, nessuna entry e nessuna previsione puntuale. Le elasticità degli asset richiedono regressioni/backtest out-of-sample.<\/div><\/div><\/section><div class=\"desk-preview-footer\">GLOBAL MACRO FX QUANT · Design v9 · Research preview · Sito pubblico invariato<\/div><\/main><\/div><script>/* GLOBAL MACRO FX QUANT v5 | Shared verified-data adapter. Display-only; never creates trading signals. */\n(()=>{'use strict';\nconst URL='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/robybizkit77-blip/global-macro-fx-quant/main/live_data/sections/';\nconst FILES={fx:'ECB_G8_PRICE_HISTORY.json',rates:'NATIVE_RATES_DATA.json',ois:'OIS_OPERATIONAL_VIEW.json',setup:'PAIR_SETUP_OPERATIONAL_VIEW.json'};\nconst CCYS=['USD','EUR','GBP','JPY','AUD','CAD','NZD','CHF'];\nconst FLAGS={USD:'🇺🇸',EUR:'🇪🇺',GBP:'🇬🇧',JPY:'🇯🇵',AUD:'🇦🇺',CAD:'🇨🇦',NZD:'🇳🇿',CHF:'🇨🇭'};\nconst LABEL={USD:'US',EUR:'DE',GBP:'UK',JPY:'JP',AUD:'AU',CAD:'CA',NZD:'NZ',CHF:'CH'};\nconst CB={USD:'Fed',EUR:'ECB',GBP:'BoE',JPY:'BoJ',AUD:'RBA',CAD:'BoC',NZD:'RBNZ',CHF:'SNB'};\nconst num=v=>(typeof v==='number'&&Number.isFinite(v)?v:null);\nconst safe=v=>String(v??'').replace(/[&<>\"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','\"':'&quot;','\\'':'&#39;'}[c]));\nconst fmt=(v,d=2)=>num(v)===null?'—':v.toFixed(d);\nconst signed=(v,d=2,sfx='')=>num(v)===null?'—':`${v>0?'+':''}${v.toFixed(d)}${sfx}`;\nconst today=()=>{const x=new Date();return Date.UTC(x.getUTCFullYear(),x.getUTCMonth(),x.getUTCDate())};\nconst age=s=>{if(!/^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$/.test((s||'').slice(0,10)))return Infinity;return Math.floor((today()-Date.parse(s.slice(0,10)+'T00:00:00Z'))/86400000)};\nconst fresh=(d,days=4)=>age(d)>=0&&age(d)<=days;\nconst flag=k=>FLAGS[k]||'🌐';\nfunction fxRows(data){if(data?.status!=='CURRENT_OFFICIAL_HISTORY'||!Array.isArray(data.rows))return[];return data.rows.filter(x=>/^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$/.test(x?.Date||'')&&x.Date<=data.last_as_of&&num(x.USD)!==null).sort((a,b)=>a.Date.localeCompare(b.Date))}\nfunction quote(x,c){if(!x||!num(x.USD))return null;const v=c==='EUR'?1:num(x[c]);return v&&v>0?({'EUR':()=>x.USD,'JPY':()=>x.JPY/x.USD,'CAD':()=>x.CAD/x.USD,'CHF':()=>x.CHF/x.USD}[c]?.()??x.USD/v):null}\nfunction pairName(c){return ({USD:'USD',EUR:'EUR/USD',GBP:'GBP/USD',JPY:'USD/JPY',AUD:'AUD/USD',CAD:'USD/CAD',NZD:'NZD/USD',CHF:'USD/CHF'})[c]||c}\nfunction strength(a,b,c){if(c==='USD')return 0;const v1=quote(a,c),v2=quote(b,c);if(!v1||!v2)return null;return ['JPY','CAD','CHF'].includes(c)?100*(v1/v2-1):100*(v2/v1-1)}\nfunction historical(x,which,asof){const h=x?.[which];if(!h)return[];let rows=Array.isArray(h)?h.map(i=>({date:i.date,value:num(i.value)})):Array.isArray(h.dates)?h.dates.map((date,i)=>({date,value:num(h.values?.[i])})):[];return rows.filter(p=>p.date&&p.date<=asof&&num(p.value)!==null).sort((a,b)=>a.date.localeCompare(b.date))}\nfunction validRates(x){const asof=x?.date;if(!fresh(asof,4)||!String(x?.quality||'').includes('OFFICIAL'))return null;const y2=num(x['2Y']),y10=num(x['10Y']);if(y2===null)return null;return {date:asof,y2,y10,history2:historical(x,'history2',asof),history10:historical(x,'history10',asof)}}\nfunction pricing(x){if(!x||!fresh(x.as_of,4)||x.operational_status==='WITHHELD')return null;\n const official=x.quality==='OFFICIAL_CERTIFIED'&&x.official_status==='ACTIVE';const estimated=x.quality==='ESTIMATED_INFORMATIONAL'&&x.operational_status==='GREEN_ESTIMATED';if(!official&&!estimated)return null;\n return {date:x.as_of,type:official?'OFFICIAL':'STIMA',source:x.source,values:Object.fromEntries(['3m','6m','12m'].map(h=>[h,num(x?.horizons?.[h]?.policy_delta_bp)]))}}\nfunction sourceStatus(j){return j?{ok:true}:{ok:false}}\nasync function getJSON(key){const file=FILES[key];if(!file)throw new Error('Unknown source');const ctrl=new AbortController();const timeout=setTimeout(()=>ctrl.abort(),12000);try{const res=await fetch(URL+file,{cache:'no-store',signal:ctrl.signal});if(!res.ok)throw new Error('Feed HTTP '+res.status);return await res.json()}finally{clearTimeout(timeout)}}\nasync function load(...keys){return Object.fromEntries(await Promise.all(keys.map(async k=>{try{return[k,await getJSON(k)]}catch(e){console.warn('[GMFQ v5 data withheld]',k,e);return [k,null]}})))}\nfunction barChart(rows,{title='Grafico a barre',suffix='%',zero=true}={}){const W=820,H=270,L=50,R=24,T=20,B=44,inner=W-L-R,ph=H-T-B;\n const usable=rows.filter(r=>num(r.value)!==null),mn=zero?Math.min(0,...usable.map(x=>x.value)):Math.min(...usable.map(x=>x.value),0),mx=zero?Math.max(0,...usable.map(x=>x.value)):Math.max(...usable.map(x=>x.value),1),limit=Math.max(Math.abs(mn),Math.abs(mx),.05)*1.15;\n const lo=zero?-limit:mn,hi=zero?limit:mx,y=v=>T+ph*(hi-v)/(hi-lo||1),base=y(0),step=inner/Math.max(rows.length,1),bw=Math.min(43,step*.5);\n let svg='';for(let i=0;i<=4;i++){let v=hi-(hi-lo)*i/4,Y=y(v);svg+=`<line x1=\"${L}\" x2=\"${W-R}\" y1=\"${Y}\" y2=\"${Y}\" stroke=\"${Math.abs(v)<.0001?'#5c7080':'#203a4b'}\" stroke-width=\".85\"/><text x=\"${L-9}\" y=\"${Y+3}\" text-anchor=\"end\" fill=\"#96b0c4\" font-size=\"12\">${v.toFixed(1)}${suffix}<\/text>`}\n rows.forEach((row,i)=>{let v=num(row.value),cx=L+step*(i+.5),X=cx-bw/2;const c=v===null?'#576a7b':v>=0?'#3dd398':'#f14960';if(v!==null){let Y=y(v);svg+=`<rect x=\"${X}\" y=\"${Math.min(Y,base)}\" width=\"${bw}\" height=\"${Math.max(1,Math.abs(Y-base))}\" rx=\"2\" fill=\"${c}\"/><text x=\"${cx}\" y=\"${v>=0?Y-8:Y+17}\" text-anchor=\"middle\" font-size=\"12\" fill=\"#e8f0f7\">${signed(v,2,suffix)}<\/text>`}svg+=`<text x=\"${cx}\" y=\"${H-15}\" text-anchor=\"middle\" fill=\"#cedfed\" font-size=\"13\">${safe(row.label)}<\/text>`});return `<svg role=\"img\" aria-label=\"${safe(title)}\" viewBox=\"0 0 ${W} ${H}\" preserveAspectRatio=\"xMidYMid meet\">${svg}<\/svg>`}\nfunction lineChart(series,{title='Storico',unit='%',xMinDate='',xMaxDate=''}={}){const W=820,H=270,L=48,R=26,T=22,B=40,w=W-L-R,h=H-T-B,pts=series.flatMap(s=>s.data||[]);if(pts.length<4)return'<div class=\"withheld\">Storico insufficiente · grafico sospeso<\/div>';const all=pts.map(p=>p.value),mn=Math.min(...all),mx=Math.max(...all),pad=Math.max(.16,(mx-mn)*.12),low=mn-pad,hi=mx+pad;const xx=(date)=>{let a=Date.parse(xMinDate+'T00:00:00Z'),b=Date.parse(xMaxDate+'T00:00:00Z'),d=Date.parse(date+'T00:00:00Z');return L+w*(d-a)/(b-a||1)},yy=v=>T+h*(hi-v)/(hi-low||1);let o='';for(let i=0;i<=4;i++){let Y=T+i*h/4,value=hi-(hi-low)*i/4;o+=`<line x1=\"${L}\" x2=\"${W-R}\" y1=\"${Y}\" y2=\"${Y}\" stroke=\"#203a4b\" stroke-width=\".85\"/><text x=\"${L-9}\" y=\"${Y+4}\" fill=\"#9cb6c9\" font-size=\"12\" text-anchor=\"end\">${value.toFixed(2)}${unit}<\/text>`}\n series.forEach(s=>{let items=(s.data||[]).filter(p=>p.date>=xMinDate&&p.date<=xMaxDate);if(items.length<2)return;o+=`<polyline fill=\"none\" stroke=\"${s.color}\" stroke-width=\"2.1\" points=\"${items.map(p=>`${xx(p.date).toFixed(1)},${yy(p.value).toFixed(1)}`).join(' ')}\"/>`});o+=`<text x=\"${L}\" y=\"${H-12}\" fill=\"#a5bfce\" font-size=\"12\">${safe(xMinDate)}<\/text><text x=\"${W-R}\" y=\"${H-12}\" text-anchor=\"end\" fill=\"#a5bfce\" font-size=\"12\">${safe(xMaxDate)}<\/text>`;return `<svg role=\"img\" aria-label=\"${safe(title)}\" viewBox=\"0 0 ${W} ${H}\" preserveAspectRatio=\"xMidYMid meet\">${o}<\/svg>`}\nwindow.GMFQ={FILES,CCYS,FLAGS,LABEL,CB,num,fmt,signed,fresh,age,flag,safe,fxRows,quote,pairName,strength,historical,validRates,pricing,load,barChart,lineChart};\n})();\n<\/script><script>(()=>{'use strict';\nconst G=window.GMFQ,$=id=>document.getElementById(id),safe=G.safe;\nconst S={\ndisinflation:{name:'Disinflazione ordinata',desc:'Inflazione si raffredda senza un forte deterioramento del lavoro. Le banche centrali possono diventare meno restrittive se anche i salari rallentano.',chain:[['MACRO','Inflazione e salari rallentano; crescita regge'],['PRICING','OIS/front-end iniziano a prezzare una stance meno restrittiva'],['RATES','2Y tende a scendere; 10Y dipende da real yields e term premium'],['FX','Differenziali e carry si riallineano in modo relativo']],assets:[['Equity','Potrebbe
